entities.name: Natural Law
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The doctrine that certain rights and moral principles are inherent in human nature and discoverable through reason alone, independent of positive law. Traced from Stoic philosophy through Aquinas to Enlightenment thinkers, natural law profoundly shaped constitutional governance, human rights declarations, and international law.
